title: Finite orbit representative data
statement: For every natural number d there are a natural number m and a family of subgroups of Perm(Fin d), with m ≤ d and each subgroup contained in the top subgroup.

proof.text: Take m=0 and the unique empty family of subgroups; zero is at most d and the containment condition is vacuous.

proof_origin.note: Strict geometric fixed-orbit descent substep of the parent theorem.
